title: Transition override
description: A user's edit of one pair's transition (editor.md). Stored per pair under the key "<fromVideoId>><toVideoId>". A missing field is Auto; an override with nothing but Auto in it is deleted.

preset.description: editor.md §2 (Spotify's presets; smooth is its Fade, none its No transition). echoOut is reserved (§5) and not valid until both apps render it.

lanes.description: Only with preset custom: each lane a shape of editor.md §3 (fx: §12), or a drawing (§10)

fx.description: editor.md §12, the Effects lane: absent is none (a none is not stored)

echoBeats.description: the echo's time in beats; absent: 0.75

delayBeats.description: the delay's time in beats; absent: 0.5

looping.description: editor.md §13, the Looping lane: a shape only, absent is none (a none is not stored)

bars.description: the window's length; absent: Auto. Ignored for loop.

window.description: editor.md §6: where the window starts in each song; absent: Auto. Ignored for loop.

out.description: A's mix-out, on A's end grid

in.description: B's mix-in, on B's opening grid; only here, delaySec (mix-file.md rule 2)

lock.description: kept past the 300-override cap; a lock beyond 300 locked is refused

family.description: only in picks migrated from {style, bars} (editor.md §1): the planner's own blend or filter mix, forced. The editor never writes it.

gridBpm.description: the tempo of A that bars and beat drawings count on (mix-file.md rule 4): an app reading A at half or double it folds the beats; not an edit on its own

speed.description: spotify-mixes.md rule 10: the speed A (out) and B (in) play at in the playlist the mix came from, pitch kept, the whole time each song plays; absent: 1

engine.description: the Automix version the user saw when saving (informational)

savedAt.description: ms since the epoch; the cap evicts the oldest unlocked

unit.description: editor.md §10 rule 1: x in beats of A from the window's start, or seconds of the mix

points.description: [x, v], sorted by x; at most 2 at one x (a step, played as an 8 ms ramp)

bar.description: the downbeat index on that song's grid, counted from its first downbeat (0); negative before it. Absent: a position in seconds only (a mix file from another app), played at the song's nearest beat to sec (editor.md §6)

beat.description: a beat within the bar (snapped to beats); absent: on the downbeat. Only with bar

nudgeMs.description: 10 ms steps on top of the snapped position

sec.description: the song time this meant when saved: the fallback when a re-analysis moves the grid by more than a beat

delaySec.description: window.in only (mix-file.md rule 2 [all]): B's late entry, the seconds after the mix starts that B stays silent before it starts at sec; the curves still run from the mix start. Absent: B starts with the mix. Ignored on window.out
